rules: Every division has one master bot responsible for broad routing and orchestration.
Low-use specialists become aliases/sub-capabilities of their division master instead of being deleted.
A specialist with unique capabilities keeps those capabilities attached to its master group.
Usage-based merging requires telemetry evidence; missing telemetry is labeled unknown rather than guessed.
Owner-selected specialists remain directly addressable for compatibility and rollback.
Buddy/DreamBot may route to hidden specialists when a specialist remains the best capability match.
Consolidation must never reduce the canonical capability inventory.
All merge decisions must be reversible and recorded with source provenance.

master_selection.fallback: highest declared capability count, then stable slug order
